I’ve had such an amazing experience at the Pitbull Store with my puppy! As a first-time puppy owner, I had a lot of questions and honestly felt a little nervous about everything, but the staff here made me feel so comfortable and welcomed.

The first time I went in, one of the male employees took so much time explaining the vaccines, the process, and everything I needed to know as a new puppy owner. He was extremely patient, informative, calm, and genuinely cared about helping me understand how to properly care for my puppy. I never once felt rushed or judged for asking questions.

The second time I came in, I was helped by one of the female employees who vaccinated my puppy, and she was just as amazing. I went right when they opened, and she had such a positive and kind attitude. She was very gentle with my puppy, took her time with everything, and made the whole experience feel comfortable and stress-free.

Coming from customer service myself at Cricket Wireless, I really appreciate when employees go above and beyond to make customers feel welcomed and cared for, and that’s exactly how I felt here. Thank you to the entire team for being so kind, professional, and helpful. I truly appreciate the care you gave my puppy and the amazing customer service!
